contracts: the reviewer table (which seat reviews which baseline part, Hanu only with L01) and one finding type are in internal/verbs/registry.go; every review timing is a [critique] key that a person owns (#919, #1032)

aayu critique --part

--seat --review : records one review per seat per baseline version on the ledger (specs//reviews/-v/.json, ready.ReviewPath) and refuses a review that is not independent: same session, same model family as the drafter, or seen another seat's review (#920)
an approved baseline starts one fresh review session per reviewing seat on the approver's agent tool, through the existing delegate receivers (#921)
the slow tick (loops/) starts each missed review, and the review window closes at [critique] review_wait_hours; Approve to build then proceeds and names the missing reviews (#922, readyapprove.go)
a local agent CLI (Codex, Copilot, OpenCode, Cursor without a key) runs a review session, and aayu critique records it when the session ends (#923)
#876 reads the recorded findings through the critique state
rollback: Reviews are append-only ledger records under each baseline version; a revert stops writing and starting them, and Approve to build sees no reviews, which is today's behaviour. The slow tick loop is removed with its file. No record is rewritten.
